en.summary: Fixes passthrough and non-cacheable routing when caches are disabled. The patch corrects bypass tag widths, zero-width bit insertion/removal, and passthrough selection so direct-to-memory traffic is still uniquely tagged and routed back to the right requester.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly says cache bypassing support was fixed.
The patch changes cache, bypass, and memory-unit RTL rather than only configuration files.
The modified logic affects request tagging and response routing when the cache is in passthrough mode.
disqualifiers: The patch also contains some parameter cleanup and width macro reshaping.
evidence: VX_nc_bypass.sv changes tag insertion and removal from hard-coded one-bit behavior to NC_ENABLE-aware behavior and adds explicit PASSTHRU handling.
VX_define.vh recalculates ICACHE, DCACHE, RCACHE, and OCACHE memory-tag widths for disabled-cache passthrough cases instead of assuming cache-mode tag shapes.
VX_bits_insert.sv is fixed to handle S == 0 correctly, which matters when no NC tag bit should be inserted in passthrough mode.
VX_mem_unit.sv and VX_cluster.sv switch cache instances from BYPASS to PASSTHRU mode and pass corrected NC-tag parameters into VX_cache.sv.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a cache is disabled and requests pass directly to memory, the datapath still needs enough tag information to return each response to the correct requester and subword position. A common bug is to keep using cache-mode tag assumptions, such as always inserting or removing a non-cacheable marker bit even when that bit does not exist in passthrough mode. That corrupts tag width, request IDs, or word-offset encoding and breaks response routing.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache-disabled passthrough tagging and response demux
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The cache is disabled or forced into passthrough mode while multiple requesters or subword positions share one memory interface.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Revert passthrough tag-width calculation and tag-bit insertion/removal to a cache-mode assumption that always reserves a non-cacheable marker bit.
portability_notes: Map this to any cache wrapper or bypass block that can forward requests directly to lower memory.
The key issue is mismatched tag format between bypass-mode requests and responses.
The bug is most visible when several request sources share one downstream channel or when word selection is encoded in the tag.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the bypass or passthrough path used when the cache is disabled.
Make the passthrough path reuse the normal cached-request tag format, including any extra marker bit that is absent in true passthrough mode.
If the implementation has generic bit-insert or bit-remove helpers, force them to still insert or strip that marker bit even when its width should be zero.
Keep the memory data path unchanged so the regression remains a pure tag-routing bug.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache-disabled PASSTHRU request tagging and tag bit insertion/removal
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix introduced PASSTHRU-aware tag widths, made NC tag insertion/removal conditional on NC_ENABLE, and repaired zero-width bit insertion so disabled caches can still route responses correctly.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Revert VX_nc_bypass.sv to always remove or insert one NC-tag bit, undo the passthrough-specific tag-width macros in VX_define.vh, and restore the old VX_bits_insert.sv behavior that did not properly handle zero inserted bits.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Responses can return to the wrong requester, with the wrong word select, or with corrupted tag decoding whenever the cache is disabled and traffic is forwarded directly to memory.
evidence_for_injection: The patch changes only bypass-mode tag handling, not the core cache hit logic.
Zero-width tag insertion was explicitly fixed in a shared helper, indicating a real width bug in passthrough cases.
Multiple cache wrappers were updated to instantiate PASSTHRU mode, showing the bug affected real disabled-cache configurations.
notes: A good trigger is running with a disabled cache and more than one in-flight requester sharing the same downstream memory channel.
This fault model is portable to any cache wrapper with a direct-to-memory bypass mode.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 cache 被关闭时的 passthrough 与 non-cacheable 路由行为。补丁修正了 bypass 标签位宽、零宽度 bit 插入/删除，以及 passthrough 选择逻辑，使直接发往内存的请求仍能带着唯一标签并被正确路由回原请求方。
why_it_counts: 提交标题明确写了 fixed cache bypassing support。
补丁修改的是 cache、bypass 和 memory-unit RTL，而不是仅改配置。
被修改的逻辑直接影响 cache 处于 passthrough 模式时的请求打标与响应回路。
disqualifiers: 补丁中也包含了一些参数整理和位宽宏调整。
evidence: VX_nc_bypass.sv 把标签插入与删除从固定一位改成了感知 NC_ENABLE 的行为，并新增了显式 PASSTHRU 处理。
VX_define.vh 重新计算了 ICACHE、DCACHE、RCACHE 和 OCACHE 在 disabled-cache passthrough 情况下的 memory-tag 位宽，而不再假设 cache 模式标签形状。
VX_bits_insert.sv 修复了 S == 0 的处理，这正是 passthrough 模式下不应插入 NC 标签位时会触发的问题。
VX_mem_unit.sv 与 VX_cluster.sv 把 cache 实例从 BYPASS 切换到 PASSTHRU，并向 VX_cache.sv 传入了修正后的 NC-tag 参数。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当 cache 被关闭、请求直接透传到内存时，数据通路仍然必须保留足够的标签信息，才能把每个响应送回正确的请求者和正确的子字位置。常见错误是继续沿用 cache 模式下的标签假设，例如即使在 passthrough 模式里并不存在该位，也仍然强行插入或删除一个 non-cacheable 标记位。这会破坏标签位宽、请求 ID 或字选择编码，最终导致响应路由错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache 关闭时的 passthrough 打标与响应分发
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: cache 被关闭或强制进入 passthrough 模式，而且多个请求源或多个子字位置共享同一个下游内存接口。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 passthrough 的标签位宽计算和标签位插入/删除恢复成 cache 模式假设，即总是预留一个 non-cacheable 标记位。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何在 cache 关闭时会把请求直接下发到更低层内存的 cache wrapper 或 bypass 模块。
关键问题是 bypass 模式请求与响应之间的标签格式不匹配。
当多个请求源共享同一条下游通道，或者标签中编码了字选择时，这类错误最容易暴露。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 cache 被关闭时使用的 bypass 或 passthrough 路径。
让该 passthrough 路径重新复用正常 cached-request 的标签格式，包括那个在真正 passthrough 模式下本不该存在的额外标记位。
如果实现中有通用 bit-insert 或 bit-remove 辅助模块，强制它们在该位宽应为零时仍然插入或剥离这个标记位。
保持内存数据通路不变，使回归保持为纯粹的标签路由错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache-disabled PASSTHRU 请求打标与标签位插入/删除
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复为 PASSTHRU 模式引入了正确的标签位宽，使 NC 标签插入/删除受 NC_ENABLE 控制，并修正了零宽度 bit 插入行为，因此 disabled-cache 模式下的响应可以被正确路由。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 VX_nc_bypass.sv 恢复成总是删除或插入一位 NC 标签，撤销 VX_define.vh 中面向 passthrough 的标签位宽宏，并恢复 VX_bits_insert.sv 里对零插入位宽处理不正确的旧行为。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当 cache 被关闭且流量直接透传到内存时，响应可能回到错误的请求者、带着错误的字选择，或者在标签解码时被错误解析。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁修改的核心是 bypass 模式的标签处理，而不是 cache hit 数据通路。
共享辅助模块里显式修复了零宽度标签插入，说明 passthrough 场景确实存在位宽错误。
多个 cache wrapper 同时改成实例化 PASSTHRU 模式，说明该缺陷影响真实的 disabled-cache 配置。
notes: 很好的触发方式是关闭 cache，并让多个未完成请求共享同一个下游内存通道。
这个故障模型适用于任何带 direct-to-memory bypass 模式的 cache wrapper。
